notes: The marginal alternative rendering was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

whom is read as the fused relative and resumptive suffix (rule 22); the competing reading leaves the suffix unrepresented. 2KI.19.16 writes a separate him for its suffix, so the relative there takes wherewith alone — the two verses are counted independently under rule 22.
אֲדֹנָיו here is the common noun אָדוֹן with a 3ms suffix, not the divine title, so rule 57 does not reach it.
